field_principles.dual_encoding_diagnostics: Keeps translation separate from reasoning errors.
field_principles.exact_replay_receipts: Records fresh-process graph and valid-set replay.
field_principles.feature_allowlist: Lists the only allowed proposal feature names.
field_principles.feature_denylist: Lists labels and provenance forbidden from features.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains the purpose of every top-level field.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Records every precondition and internal gate.
field_principles.graph_hashes: Pins each source transformation graph and exact valid set.
field_principles.inference_substrate: States that only CPU transforms of frozen outputs ran.
field_principles.live_llm_invoked: Proves that no live model call was made.
field_principles.matching_receipts: Records nuisance matching for every paired probe.
field_principles.model_output_constraint_probe_ready: States whether the fixture passed all gates.
field_principles.rows: Stores valid and cross-dependency-fail candidate rows.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Pins every source and supporting artifact byte hash.
field_principles.source_model_specs: Retains mandated GGUF models as provenance strata.
field_principles.split_manifest: Proves case isolation and stratum coverage.
field_principles.status: States whether the ready or blocked fixture completed.
field_principles.transformation_contract: Freezes formal operations and matching tolerances.
field_principles.verdict_class: Reports one closed-enum terminal verdict class.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Prevents treating the verifier as an independent oracle.

observed.assignment_rule: within each constraint family, sorted source stream case index modulo three equals zero is held_case; all other indices are development

honest_verdict: complete: frozen authentic outputs produced exact paired formal probes
inference_substrate: deterministic_verifier -- CPU transform of frozen authentic mandated-GGUF outputs; no new LLM inference and no source-output replacement

split_manifest.assignment_rule: within each constraint family, sorted source stream case index modulo three equals zero is held_case; all other indices are development

transformation_contract.refinement: add one satisfiable unary clause; strict subset; unchanged variable set, representation, and cross-variable dependency topology
transformation_contract.restructuring: replace one same-width clause; preserve variable and clause counts; change dependency topology; produce support incomparable with base
